# LabGoblin instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `AI_CONTEXT.md`, and `docs/brand.md`. This is classroom infrastructure software branded as **LabGoblin — Virtual Lab Provisioning & Management**. Use LabGoblin for all user-facing text and LabGoblin-owned technical identifiers. The canonical repository is `wagnerks1990/labgoblin`; do not preserve retired application-owned repository, deployment, database, cookie, service, package, logger, or helper identifiers in this fresh-install development baseline. Treat Proxmox VE as an infrastructure integration, not the product name. Default-deny tenant access, persist every Proxmox mutation as a durable operation, require previews for destructive actions, keep secrets server-side, use linear Alembic migrations, regenerate the OpenAPI contract, and update the wiki with behavior changes. Never claim that mocks validate a live Proxmox deployment.
